scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run architecture
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser.cjs && node tests/media-browser.cjs && node tests/clipboard-browser.cjs && node tests/options-browser.cjs && node tests/workspace-browser.cjs && node tests/launcher-browser.cjs && node tests/playlist-browser.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run architecture && npm run unused && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:browser:packaged: npm run build && SHORTCUTS_TEST_EXTENSION=./dist npm run test:browser
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests docs *.json *.mjs *.cjs AGENTS.md README.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests docs *.json *.mjs *.cjs AGENTS.md README.md .github
